questions.q: How did the baker check the sourdough loaves?
options: Rapped his knuckles on the underside, listening for a hollow knock
Pressed the crust with his thumb
Weighed them on a brass scale

questions.q: Which jar on the shelf was nearly empty?
What did the first customer of the day buy?
options: The same seeded rye she has bought every morning for thirty years
The braided loaf with the egg wash
